new_component.description: Uniform terminal factorization for a simple regular graph of even order with no overfull set and exactly three disjoint covering robust core parts. Fixed positive ambient degree and part-order densities and robust parameters precede a common positive core-error tolerance and order threshold. Joining palettes, completed perfect-matching prefixes, residual cores, the simultaneous contraction of the two odd parts, and compatible leaf colorings are constructed from the original host hypotheses. The conclusion is a coloring and an exact partition of all original edge copies into the degree number of perfect matchings. This proves only the three-core subcase of Proposition 4.16; the four-core cases, full Proposition 4.16, and the main theorem remain unproved. Numbered coverage stays 48 of 69.
new_component.scope_limit: Exactly the three-core terminal subcase. The four-core cases, complete Proposition 4.16, and the main theorem remain unproved; no numbered assertion is promoted.

old_scope: Complete Corollary 4.6 for even regular multigraphs with no overfull set and either one robust core with at most three exceptional vertices or two robust cores with at most two exceptional vertices. Fixed positive degree and core-order densities and robust parameters precede one common positive core-error tolerance and order threshold. The conclusion constructs a coloring and an exact partition of all original edge copies into k perfect matchings. No representative matching, reserve, complementary coloring or residual factorization is assumed. Full fixed-pattern Lemma 4.4, five-exception Corollary 4.5, terminal Proposition 4.16 and the main theorem remain unproved. The current candidate has 48 of 69 complete numbered assertions; the full frozen verifier and axiom audit establish its verification status.
